hypotheses.label: Source-forced constellation: not / But / public / than / religion / religious
hypotheses.research_question: Which distinctions, dependencies or representation failures among not, But, public, than, religion, religious, would, Mussulmans, pork become invisible when the current topic registry determines the problem in advance?

rival_unitizations.description: Treat recurrent source-native terms as a provisional local field before assigning a known ontological relation type.
rival_unitizations.analytic_consequence: The operator asks which distinctions appear from term co-presence without presupposing relation-first, relata-first, dependence or reciprocity.

rival_unitizations.description: Treat changes between adjacent argument windows as the primary analytic event rather than assuming one corpus-wide profile.
rival_unitizations.analytic_consequence: The operator preserves local regime shifts and can route different windows differently without turning variation into a universal ontology.

rival_unitizations.description: Treat recurrent absences and broken co-occurrences as provisional boundaries of the source's problem-space.
rival_unitizations.analytic_consequence: The operator can register what ceases to travel together without claiming that absence itself names a metaphysical structure.

proposed_executable_family.title: Open-set source family: not / But / public / than
proposed_executable_family.diagnostic: What becomes visible in the local source field (not, But, public, than, religion, religious) before it is translated into a pre-existing operator family?
proposed_executable_family.constructive_move: Compare term-field, window-transition and negative-boundary unitizations; preserve a null result when none adds a source-linked distinction.
proposed_executable_family.self_risk: Open-set discovery can become an exception factory that rewards novelty; retire the family if it does not add repeatable local discrimination beyond ordinary routing.
proposed_executable_family.positive_model: Micro-local source-signature probe with no presupposed ontology and explicit rollback to ordinary routing.

hypotheses.source_resistance_trigger: Curated topic coverage captured 0/9 source-central terms; 9 remained outside the recognized problem-space.
hypotheses.revision_condition: Re-run after operator mutation. The emergent constellation is retired only if source-central terms become covered without forcing them into an unrelated legacy topic or erasing their local relations.
